d:
Satish dhavan antriksh kendr (es.di.es.si.) shar, shrihrikota ke dvitiy pramochan paid se bhutulyakali upagrah pramochak roket (ji.es.el.vi.-eph10) dvara bhu-pratibinban upagrah (ji.aaee.sait-1) ka pramochan kiya jaega.
Ji.aaee.sait-1 ka vajan lagbhag 2275 ki.gra. hai aur yah ek atyadhunik daksh bhu-prekshan upagrah hai, jise ji.es.el.vi.-eph10 dvara bhutulyakali antran kaksha men sthapit kiya jaega. tadnantar, us men lagi nodan pranali ka upyog karte hue yah upagrah antim bhusthir kaksha men pahunch jaega.
